large_quantity_definition: Profile eligible order total quantity >= pooled order 90th percentile; include ties; descriptive not identity label
repeat_definition: Number of order-SKU occurrences bought at strictly earlier timestamps / order-SKU occurrences in orders with earlier history; first timestamp excluded; no earlier history => NA
interval_definition: Adjacent invoice timestamp differences in days; simultaneous orders may yield zero; one order => NA
category_definition: Existing taxonomy_v1; missing and other excluded only from category features; SKU quantity and money retained
customer_weighting: Customer feature medians and IQR, one customer one vote
limitations: No wholesale/retail ground truth or classification accuracy
RFM frequency and monetary are reused; their separation is expected, not independent validation
Replenishment observation opportunity differs with order frequency; first purchase is left-censored by Profile boundary
Same-subcategory SKUs are assortment proxies, not verified model/color variants
Taxonomy_v1 retrospectively applied; taxonomy built later, not a prospectively frozen Profile-only labeling experiment
No downstream Discovery/Validation/Test transactions used for feature values; no future validation performed
Outliers preserved under upstream cleaning; medians/IQR used; returns excluded so amounts are gross purchases
